title: B-2 colonel whispers about electrogravitics

tellings.quote: and he leaned forward and he just whispered, "That's bullshit."

plain: At a conference in Las Vegas in 2008, a colonel connected with the B-2 stealth bomber is said to have leaned forward and whispered, "That's bullshit," when the talk turned to electrogravitics, the idea of moving an aircraft with strong electric fields instead of ordinary engines. The researcher Richard Dolan says he was there, and he links the moment to a paper by Paul LaViolette on electrogravitics and the B-2, an idea that goes back to the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown. Dolan tells it as a hint of what people close to the bomber may know about how it flies.
